triage.kind_span: The Fund is issuing transferable rights (“Rights”)

subject_names.span: Aberdeen Income Credit Strategies Fund (the “Fund”) is a diversified, closed-end management investment company.

subject_tickers.span: listed on the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) under the symbol “ACP”

security_class.span: to its common shareholders of record as of the close of business on May 20, 2021 (the “Record Date”)

rights_per_share.span: will receive one Right for each outstanding Common Share owned on the Record Date

rights_per_new_share.span: The Rights entitle the holders to purchase one new Common Share for every three Rights held (1 for 3)

price_reference.span: 92.5% of the average of the last reported sales price of a Common Share on the NYSE on the Expiration Date

price_pct.span: 92.5% of the average of the last reported sales price of a Common Share on the NYSE on the Expiration Date

price_floor_pct_nav.span: If, however, the Formula Price is less than 87% of the Fund’s net asset value (“NAV”) per Common Share

record_date.span: to its common shareholders of record as of the close of business on May 20, 2021 (the “Record Date”)

expiration_date.span: The Offer will expire at 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on June 16, 2021, unless extended as described

transferable.span: The Rights are transferable and will be admitted for trading on the NYSE under the symbol during the course of the Offer

over_subscription.span: will be entitled to an over-subscription privilege under which they may subscribe for additional Common Shares which were not subscribed for by other Rights holders at the Subscription Price

max_new_shares.span: subscribe (the “Offer”) for an aggregate of 5,812,247 common shares of beneficial interest

notes: 424B2 prospectus supplement (to prospectus dated April 27, 2021) for a transferable rights offering by Aberdeen Income Credit Strategies Fund (NYSE: ACP), 1 right per common share, 3 rights per new share, up to 5,812,247 shares. Subscription price is a formula: 92.5% of the average NYSE last sale over the Expiration Date and the four prior trading days, floored at 87% of NAV; price_reference is set to market because the formula references market price, with the 87% NAV floor recorded as price_floor_pct_nav. The $11.11 figure is labelled an estimate computed on May 17, 2021 prices and is not the Expiration Date price, so it is not used as a field. Expiration June 16, 2021 is the date stated in this document; no extension is stated in the excerpt. Excerpt ends mid-sentence inside the Dilution section of the Offer, so terms appearing only after the cut are null; none of the 13 fields depend on text after the cut.
